events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Trailblazing guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, leaving an indelible mark on music history.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix revolutionised the electric guitar. Which of his solos still gives you goosebumps?

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, "Abbey Road," featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover, was released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: That cover, those songs. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album still sounds as fresh as ever. What's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman and rock icon Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are timeless.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam track, solo or with Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK in October 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since its UK single release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' continues to inspire. A powerful message, then and now.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced its groundbreaking first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how the world listened to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember when the iPod changed everything? Twenty-five years since its launch, it's hard to imagine music without it.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, "Dr. No," on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the most iconic 007 moment for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: A sprawling, diverse, and utterly brilliant album. The Beatles' 'White Album' is still a talking point almost 60 years on.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, aged 45.

angles.name: A True Icon
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: Rubber Soul Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A New Direction
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a pivotal moment in their evolution. Which track stands out for you?
